summary: Iteration 2 backend+frontend verification. All 23 pytest cases (14 legacy + 9 new for flag/settings/sub_location/size_notes/XXL-XXXL/category-delete/location-counts/back-compat) PASS (100%). Playwright E2E verified: Dashboard tile 'Flagged' + no size distribution, Settings tab route+fields+save+category CRUD, Locations expandable rows (7 toggles, expanded row lists 2 costumes), Inventory flagged filter + flag-badge on card + sub_location display, CostumeFormDialog fields for sub_location/XXL/XXXL/flag switch (form-flag-reason reveals after toggling switch), and CostumeDetail flag banner + unflag button + detail-size-XXL/XXXL cells + banner disappears after unflag.

minor.issue: Ghost categories are synthesized from costumes that use a category name not in the categories collection. These synthesized entries get a fresh uuid on every call, so their id is not stable and DELETE /api/categories/{id} on such a synthesized id returns 404 (only real seeded/created rows can be deleted). Consider persisting categories on first use or excluding synthesized ones from the delete UI.
Non-empty string for org_name is not enforced; accepts empty string and other whitespace. Consider validation.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking form-size-note-btn-{S/M} does not reliably reveal the size-note-panel-{s} / form-size-note-{s} textarea in Playwright (state toggles appear to not open the panel on first click in some cases). Reproduced twice on fresh dialogs. Underlying data flow works (size_notes persist via API), but UX may be confusing for users. Recommend verifying the setOpenSizeNote handler / z-index / focus state.

issues: List view table not verified in this iteration; grid + card layout looks clean with a subtle red FLAGGED ribbon on the image and 'Costume Closet A · B5' shown as location · sub_location. Contrast and spacing on all pages are good.
'CUSTOM / FREE-TEXT LOCATIONS' divider only appears when orphan free-text locations exist in data (correct behaviour). No orphans were present in this environment so the divider was absent.

action_items: Investigate CostumeFormDialog size-note-btn click handler — panel does not open reliably; verify openSizeNote state toggle and re-render.
Optional: persist synthesized categories on read so DELETE /api/categories/{id} works for categories that were created implicitly via a costume.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to FastAPI lifespan.
server.py getObject/putObject use synchronous requests inside async handlers; still blocks event loop.
list_categories() generates fresh uuids on every request for costume-derived categories — id instability breaks any client-side caching or delete flow relying on that id.

CostumeUpdate uses exclude_none=True; passing empty strings for sub_location / notes still updates them (intentional), but this also means clients can't 'unset back to None' — acceptable given the field default is empty string.
Settings has a single doc keyed on id='app'; upsert=True in PUT is correct. GET creates the doc on first call which is fine.
SettingsUpdate lacks validation for org_name length or emptiness; consider adding constraints.

Frontend testids match the spec 1:1. Only concern: form-size-note-btn-{s} panel reveal — verify manually or with a slight extra wait/click.
rca of the issue: For the size-note reveal issue: the handler is `onClick={() => setOpenSizeNote(openSizeNote === s ? null : s)}`. If Playwright's programmatic click event lands twice or the button already had openSizeNote===s from a previous mount, it would toggle it back to null. Suggest inspecting whether the click event bubbles/re-fires or whether the state is initialized correctly on dialog open (setOpenSizeNote(null) should be called in the dialog open effect).
